claim.value: If small numbers or the three-week deadline prevent a reproducible result, the account should report insufficiency rather than conclude that responsibility ambiguity has no effect.
claim.scope: A conditional interpretation of limited observations; failure to obtain reproducibility under these constraints is not a no-effect finding.

provenance.rationale: P027 supplies the observation constraints and reporting consequence; P003 identifies the suspected factor as responsibility ambiguity.

signal_basis.value: Compare missing-attachment frequency before and after responsibility becomes explicit using comparable orders and consistent inspection intervals. If limited volume or the deadline prevents a reproducible result, the observations are insufficient to determine that ambiguity has no effect.
signal_basis.scope: Limited observations of attachment outcomes within the three-week review window.

provenance.rationale: These spans specify the comparison, the proposed repeated signal, and the interpretation when volume or time prevents reproducibility.
The claim is supported within its stated bounds; no unresolved empirical relation is needed to license this limitation.

rationale: Failure to obtain a reproducible result because observations are too few or follow-up is too short does not establish absence of an effect. Reporting insufficiency is therefore warranted under the claim's explicit conditions.
uncertainty: The existence and size of any effect remain unresolved under those conditions; this does not undermine the reporting claim.
